description: Searches EasyCircuit's electronics parts catalog by name, function or role (for example 'OLED display', 'temperature sensor', 'ESP32 board'). Returns matching parts with their catalog ids, interfaces, pin roles, and whether each can be ordered in a kit.

availability.description: one_click limits results to parts orderable in a kit.

query.description: What the part is or does.

role.description: Optional circuit role, e.g. controller, sensor, load.

name: search_parts
title: Search parts catalog
